sights.n: Ningle Terrace, Furano (ニングルテラス)
sights.address: Nakagoryō, Furano, Hokkaido, Japan (New Furano Prince Hotel grounds)
sights.w: About fifteen log-cabin craft shops linked by boardwalks in the Furano forest — silver snowflake charms, woodcarving, leather; lantern-lit after dark.

sights.address: Biei, Kamikawa District, Hokkaido, Japan (former primary school)
sights.w: Landscape photographer Shinzō Maeda's gallery of the Biei hills he made famous, in a converted primary school among birch groves.

sights.n: Kawamura Kaneto Ainu Memorial Museum (川村カ子トアイヌ記念館)
sights.w: Founded 1916 — Japan's oldest Ainu cultural museum, run by an Ainu family in the old Chikabumi kotan, with a reconstructed bamboo-grass cise house.

sights.n: Hakuchō Ōhashi Bridge, Muroran (白鳥大橋)
sights.address: Muroran, Hokkaido, Japan (Route 37 across Muroran Port)
sights.w: Eastern Japan's longest suspension bridge, spanning Muroran harbour — lit at night above the city's famous factory-night views.
